law: Cuts found by the feasibility artifact are assigned to named existing owners. BWH1 does not locally substitute a missing producer or introduce a second authority. An incompatible core dependency that needs a semantic redesign is a receiving-owner amendment before production mutation (BWH1.3).

rules: A reduced-semantic stub must not be retained as the product (BWH1.2); these cuts record seams, they do not ship a fake TypeInfo.
